paper.title_en: Large-$N$ Carrollian Thermodynamics from AdS Black-Hole Phase-Space Contractions
paper.abstract_en: We develop the boundary large-rank interpretation of finite Carrollian black-hole thermodynamics and its sourced stress, scalar spectral and interacting thermal observables. Correlated scaling of the time generator and Newton coupling preserves the extended Hamiltonian differential while the generator temperature vanishes and the holographic normalization grows. The Brown--York source variation fixes the relative weights of energy density, momentum density and spatial stress, giving Ward equations on the Carrollian and thermal time scales. Boundary volume and normalization variations reproduce the bulk pressure work and characterize the Hawking--Page crossing through a chemical potential. Source coupling fixes the scalar operator map and spectral clock Jacobian. Numerical solutions in four-dimensional Schwarzschild-AdS determine angular transmission and finite-frequency absorption. In the type IIB family, the logarithmic scrambling interval imposes an additional hierarchy between rank and 't Hooft coupling. We derive a correlated limit in which the string length vanishes while a finite transverse Regge kernel survives in the normalized four-point functional. Its integrated attenuation and spatial width obey a common relation. This interacting observable distinguishes large-rank sequences with the same leading thermodynamics and asymptotic Regge growth rate. Thermal Fourier--Mellin moments retain the scalar spectrum in a contracting frequency window. Time translations shift their weights with angular source terms retained. The BTZ dictionary supplies the corresponding large-central-charge equilibrium example.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文在Carrollian极限下重新表述有限Carrollian黑洞热力学，结合边界大秩解释、Brown-York源变分与Ward方程，并给出Schwarzschild-AdS数值解及type IIB中的Regge核分析，理论深度高、方法信号强，对黑洞热力学与全息对偶方向的研究者有明确的点击阅读价值。
decision.title_zh: 从AdS黑洞相空间收缩得到的大$N$ Carrollian热力学
decision.abstract_zh: 我们发展了有限Carrollian黑洞热力学的边界大秩解释，以及其有源应力、标量谱和相互作用的熱观测量的对应描述。时间生成元与牛顿耦合的关联标度保持了扩展哈密顿微分的结构，同时生成元温度趋于零而全息归一化因子增大。Brown--York源变分确定了能量密度、动量密度和空间应力的相对权重，给出了Carrollian时间尺度与热时间尺度上的Ward方程。边界体积与归一化变分重现了体压力做功，并通过化学势刻画了Hawking--Page相交。源耦合确定了标量算符映射和谱时钟雅可比行列式。四维Schwarzschild-AdS中的数值解确定了角度透射率和有限频率吸收。在type IIB族中，对数化扰乱间隔在秩与't Hooft耦合之间施加了额外的等级关系。我们推导出一个关联极限：弦长趋于零，而在归一化四点泛函中一个有限的横向Regge核依然存在。其积分衰减与空间宽度满足一个共同的关系。这个相互作用观测量可以区分具有相同领头热力学和渐近Regge增长速率的大秩序列。热Fourier--Mellin矩在收缩频率窗口内保留了标量谱。时间平移改变其权重，同时保留角度源项。BTZ对应提供了相应的大中心荷平衡态例子。
